label: Enable Arc Converter
description: Master switch for automatic item processing.

label: Weapons
description: Automatically process only newly acquired weapons at the selected tiers. Existing weapons are not scanned.

label: Weapon action
description: Choose whether eligible newly acquired weapons are sold for eddies or disassembled into components.

label: Tier 1 (+ variants)
description: Process eligible Tier 1 weapons acquired after enabling the mod.

label: Clothes
description: Automatically process only newly acquired clothing at selected tiers. Existing clothing is not scanned.

label: Automatically craft ammunition
description: Use vanilla crafting and components to replenish ammunition for the currently equipped weapon.

label: Craft when reserve below (%)
description: Craft one vanilla recipe batch when ammunition falls below this percentage of its capacity. Never exceed the game's ammo limit.

label: Automatically process junk
description: Process junk and jewelry, including existing stacks, using the selected junk action.

label: Junk action
description: Sell, disassemble or use the unit price threshold. Ineligible items are kept.

label: Price threshold (€$)
description: In By value mode, disassemble at or below this unit price; sell above it.

label: Food and drinks
description: Process eligible existing and newly acquired stacks. Off by default.
